RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the February 25, 2003/Phalguna 6, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministeries:  Civil Aviation: Finance and Company Affairs; Petroleum and

Total Number of Questions—20

Use of Smart photo identity cards at
airports
†*101. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to issue new smart photo identity cards for
entry at all major international airports of
the country keeping in view the increasing
threat of terrorism, of hijacking and of
implanting bombs;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when cards are likely to be issued;
and
(d) the estimated amount likely to be spent
on this work?
Fund for expansion of AI and IA
*102. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of expansion plans for
Indian Airlines and Air India to increase
frequencies both in domestic and
International;
(b) what are the likely sources of funds
required for the purpose; and
(c) what will be the estimated share of
air travel of these airlines after the
enhancement of their fleets?
Delay in tax refunds
*103. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news item captioned
"inordinate delay in most tax refunds, shows
survey" appearing in the Economic Times,
New Delhi dated the 24th December, 2002;
(b) if so, the number of cases of refund
pending with the Income Tax Department,
Delhi as on 31st January, 2003; and
(c) by when all these refunds cases are
likely to be cleared?
Gas reserves at Andhra Pradesh
*104. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) what steps Government have taken
to tap the newly discovered gas reserves off
Andhra Pradesh coast by Reliance
Industries;
(b) whether an estimate has been made
of quantum of gas reserves; and
(c) by when commercial use of gas
reserves is likely to start?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

2
WIN2\SESSION\7420RS 2
Printing away of small investors in
stock market
*105. SHRI SURESH PANCHOURI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether small investors have drifted
away from the stock market recently;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) what decisions have been taken by
Government to build confidence of small
investors in the stock market?
Commencement of production for
explored locations
*106. SHRI MOTI LAL VORA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of new oil and gas
explorations both offshore and inland during
the last three years;
(b) whether it is a fact that production
has not yet begun in the locations explored
in the past;
(c) if so, what is the present oil and gas
production from these locations; and
(d) if the reply to part (b) above be in the
negative the reasons thefor and by when
production is likely to start?
Low foreign investment by US
*107. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY:
SHRIMATI SHABANA AZMI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the US
Business Houses are invest in India;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) the steps proposed to be taken in this
regard; and
(d) whether Government propose to
make certain changes so that US are ready
to invest in India?
Task Force on Operational parameters
for corporate governance
*108. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will
the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a task force
was constituted by Government to evolve a
set of operational parameters for ensuring
good corporate governance;
(b) if so, the terms of reference of the
Task Force;
(c) whether the task Force has since
submitted its report;
(d) if so, what are the salient features of
the report and if the likely to part (c) above
the reasons therefor; and
(e) the action taken by Government on
the Report and if not, the reasons therefor?
LPG Pipeline between visakhapatnam
and Hyderabad
*109. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Gas Authority of India Ltd.
(GAIL) is planning to convert its Rs. 490
crores exclusive LPG pipeline into a natural
Gas transportation pipeline which runs from
Visakhapatnam to Hyderabad and
Secunderabad; and
(b) the details of the steps being taken to
develop gas distribution network in
Visakhapatnam, Amlapuram, Bhimavaram,
Rajamundry, Kakinada and Secunderabad
which are on the rout of the pipeline?

WIN2\SESSION\7338RS 73
Installation of Advanced Landing
System at Airports
627. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an Advanced
Landing System was installed recently at
Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi;
(b) if so, what was the total expense
incurred for this new system;
(c) whether Government have plans to
install simular system at all major
international airports of the country; and
(d) if so, by when?
Enhancing FDI limit for domestic
aviation
628. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
contemplating to enhance the FDI limit in
domestic aviation;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that it is also
proposed to allow foreign airlines on operate
on domestic routes;
(d) if so, the details in this regard;
(e) whether reciprocal arrangement is
sought for Air India to operate in the
domestic air routes of the such countries;
and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Operation of Indian Commercial
Flights over Pakistan
629. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA MURTHY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of Pakistan
has alowed Indian Commercial flights to
operate over its skies;
(b) if not, whether there is an increase in
passenger and cargo tariff whether for
passengers or cargo as a result thereof;
(c) if so, whether Government have
plans to negotiate with the Pakistani
authorities regarding the use of its skies for
commercial flights; and
(d) if so, the details of the negotiations
reached so far?

Notification on route rationalisation
630. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
of Civil Aviation has issued a route
rationalisation notification recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the notification is applicable
only to Indian Airlines and Air India or it
applies to private players also;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Profitt/lLosses of AI and IA
†631. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state the profits earned of losses
suffered by the Air India and the Indian
Airlines during the last three years?
Amendments in AAI Act, 1994
632. SHRI JANARDHANA POOJ-
ARY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
amend the Airports Authority of India Act,
1994 vis-a-vis the Bangalore International
Airport project; and
(b) if so, the details in this regard?
Allowing Domestic/private airlines to
fly to foreign destinations
633. SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have permitted
some domestic private airlines to fly to
foreign destinations also;
(b) if so, the reasons and justification
therefor;
(c) the benefits to accrue to the
Government on allowing domestic/private
airlines to fly foreign distinations;
(d) whether such a decision will have an
adverse impact on Air India and Indian
Airlines; and
(e) if so, the steps taken to check such
impact?
Change in names of airports
634. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether names of some Airports have
been changed;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any expense was increased
by the Airports Authority of India in issuign
advertisement in relation to change of name
of airports; and
(d) if so, the details of amount spent,
airport-wise?
Media publicity of AAI
635. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) what is the budget of Media publicity
of Airports Authority of India every year; and
(b) the amount spent by Airports
Authority of India on such media publicity
during the last three years-wise ?

Ground handling at airports
636. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether private individuals and
Indian Companies are debarred for the
ground handling inside the Airports; and
(b) whether it is a fact that many
companies are supplying manpower to
various Airlines for ground handling?
Review of discounts schemes offered
by IA
